$comment: The first section of the front page, the latest month (src/lib/latestMonth.ts, drawn by src/components/LatestMonth.astro). It is worked out when the site is built, from the files in public/data, and ships no script. It reads true registrations: the dataset below, never the survivors dataset, and the two are never on one chart. To point it at another dataset, change `dataset` and nothing else. A block that names a field is drawn only where the manifest lists that field as live for the dataset and its slice can be read, so a field the build has not published yet (a block already listed here) leaves no gap and no empty box; the same holds for the whole section when the dataset is not built. `blocks` is the order they are drawn in. kind: total (the month's figure and its change on the same month a year earlier), split (every value of a field, with its share and the change in its share), ranking (the largest values, with their counts and change on a year ago), movers (the values whose count rose most and fell most on a year ago: each side shows `each` values, both months need `minimum` vehicles, and a change smaller than `least` is not a move). `definition` is the address of the definition of what the block counts, on the method page; tests/site/latest-month.test.ts holds each anchor to a heading that exists. `canvas` says which chart the block opens in the canvas: the measure, whether it is broken down by the block's field, the chart type (null: the best fit) and the chart's own settings (src/lib/builder.ts, CHART_PARAMS); tests/site/latest-month.test.ts reads each link back with the canvas's own reader. A change on a year ago is withheld where the same month a year earlier has fewer vehicles than the change floor in config/measures.json (the yoy measure), where the value has no figure then, or where an event that changed how the data is recorded lies between the two months (CLAUDE.md invariant 7). A count the build hides (the small-cell rule) is shown as hidden and is never read as zero. Every text under `words` is a template held to config/narrative/rules.json (kind latest_month) by pipeline/tests/test_site_config.py: it names no figure, year or value of a field, says what the data shows and never why, and is dropped where it cannot be filled. `view_field` is the field whose values the vehicles are counted under (new or used): the month's figure is said by them, and a block with `views` is drawn once for each value and once for all of them behind one switch that needs no script (src/components/ViewSwitch.astro), each with its own sentence, table and link to the canvas, which keeps the question to that value. A value ranks by its own count among the vehicles of that value; for a field the build caps, only above the fewest vehicles any value the build names has, since a value grouped as other may have more. The figures are cut from the fact table (src/lib/conditionViewsBuild.ts) and used only where they agree with the field's slice; where any block cannot be made, none has views. `market` is before the blocks with views because its field is not in the fact table and cannot be split.
